title: Haar decompression and amenability of Ellis flows
summary: Let $(X,G)$ be a tame flow and let $K$ be an Ellis group of its enveloping semigroup $E(X,G)$. Although $K$ is a compact Hausdorff topological group in its $τ$-topology, the inclusion $K\hookrightarrow E(X,G)$ need not be Borel. We show that normalized Haar measure on $K$ nevertheless determines, via the Riesz--Markov theorem, a canonical regular Borel probability measure $μ_K$ on $E(X,G)$, called its Haar decompression.
